class.name: OcgToplocSlistofitemlocation
class.brief_description: An SListOfItemLocation is a LISP like list of Items. An SListOfItemLocation is : . Empty. . Or it has a Value and a Tail which is an other SListOfItemLocation.
class.description: ! An SListOfItemLocation is a LISP like list of Items. ! An SListOfItemLocation is : ! . Empty. ! . Or it has a Value and a Tail which is an other SListOfItemLocation. ! ! The Tail of an empty list is an empty list. ! SListOfItemLocation are shared. It means that they can be ! modified through other lists. ! SListOfItemLocation may be used as Iterators. They have Next, ! More, and value methods. To iterate on the content ! of the list S just do. ! ! SListOfItemLocation Iterator; ! for (Iterator = S; Iterator.More(); Iterator.Next()) ! X = Iterator.Value();

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a list from an other one. The lists are shared.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Creates a List with <anItem> as value and <aTail> as tail.

method.name: Assign
method.description: Sets a list from an other one. The lists are shared. The list itself is returned.

method.name: IsEmpty
method.description: Return true if this list is empty

method.name: Clear
method.description: Sets the list to be empty.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the current value of the list. An error is raised if the list is empty.

method.name: Tail
method.description: Returns the current tail of the list. On an empty list the tail is the list itself.

method.name: Construct
method.description: Replaces the list by a list with <anItem> as Value and the list <me> as tail.

method.name: ToTail
method.description: Replaces the list <me> by its tail.

method.name: More
method.description: Returns True if the iterator has a current value. This is !IsEmpty()

method.name: Next
method.description: Moves the iterator to the next object in the list. If the iterator is empty it will stay empty. This is ToTail()
